course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: A music player stored its collection of songs in a doubly linked list, where each node (23) [CO1] contains the song title, the singer's name, and a pointer to the next node.
i) Design an algorithm to sort the linked list of songs lexicographically by the singer's names using merge sort.
ii) Write an algorithm to insert a new song at a specified valid position in the linked list. Assume that the linked list is not empty and the given position is valid.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2024
